title: Hidung Bang Mamat
genre: Betawi samrah pop (harmonium, gambus and marwas)
subject: A Betawi man whose nose has been blocked since August buys perfume for his girlfriend by making the Blok M shop assistant describe every bottle, then finds the words he borrowed are exactly what she smells
caption: Betawi samrah pop, Malay-Betawi party style. A harmonium plays the lilting main melody, a gambus doubles it with plucked ornaments, marwas hand drums and a tambourine drive a bouncy two-beat dance rhythm, a violin answers each line, no drum kit. Warm room sound, light spring reverb, close and lively. A male lead sings with a bright Betawi lilt, clearly sung melody with a small playful lift at line ends. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, G minor. Cheeky, teasing mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no rap, no trap hi-hats, no distorted guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - harmonium, marwas]

[Verse 1]
Bang Mamat masuk toko wangi di Blok M
Hidungnya mampet dari bulan Agustus
Mbak penjual nyodorin botol satu-satu
Bang Mamat nyengir, kagak ada yang kecium

[Pre-Chorus]
Mbak, bilangin aja deh
Wanginya kayak apa

[Chorus]
Kata Mbak ini kayak mangga abis ujan
Yang itu kayak sabun nenek pagi hari
Ane kagak ngerti, ane percaya aja
Bungkusin dua, biar Neng seneng hati

[Verse 2]
Di rumah Neng Lastri ia sodorin botol
Neng cium, Neng senyum, Neng bilang mangga abis ujan
Persis kata Mbak toko, Bang Mamat kaget
Padahal itu kata Mbak toko semua

[Chorus]
Kata Neng ini wangi mangga abis ujan
Bang Mamat ketawa, hidungnya masih mampet
Ane kagak ngerti, ane percaya aja
Yang wangi tuh Neng, bukan cuma botolnya

[Outro - violin, harmonium]
Bungkusin dua, bungkusin dua
Biar Neng seneng hati
